author: Andrew Fisher
scope: CPU lifecycle fault injection; no GPU or service calls

checks.name: normal render installs once and retains original renderer
track partial install failure disposes and renders original
architecture partial install failure disposes and renders original
vegetation partial install failure disposes and renders original
installation failure is sticky without automatic retry
explicit enable retries successfully after a fault
bloom disabled before frame restores exact original foliage resources
bloom disabled scene does not reinstall on every frame
deliberate quality restoration reinstalls without altering drive or camera
composite allocation failure during render redraws original exactly once
enhanced draw error falls back once and is not retried every frame
original renderer errors are not silently swallowed
explicit detail off releases resources and remains off
unmount disposes additions before the original lifecycle
offline renderer without mount remains supported
context lost scene does not allocate optional resources
